module origen_176243(
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input MemRead,
    input MemWrite,
    input [31:0] address,
    input [31:0] write_data,
    output reg [31:0] read_data
);

    reg [31:0] memory [0:15];

    initial begin
        memory[0] = 32'd0;
        memory[1] = 32'd1;
        memory[2] = 32'd2;
        memory[3] = 32'd3;
        memory[4] = 32'd4;
        memory[5] = 32'd5;
        memory[6] = 32'd6;
        memory[7] = 32'd7;
        memory[8] = 32'd8;
        memory[9] = 32'd9;
        memory[10] = 32'd10;
        memory[11] = 32'd11;
        memory[12] = 32'd12;
        memory[13] = 32'd13;
        memory[14] = 32'd14;
        memory[15] = 32'd15;
    end

    reg [31:0] read_data_reg;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            // Reset the module
            read_data_reg <= 32'b0;
        end
        else begin
            if (MemRead) begin
                read_data_reg <= memory[address[4:0]];
            end
            if (MemWrite) begin
                memory[address[4:0]] <= write_data;
            end
        end
    end

    // Assign the read_data_reg to the output port
    always @(*) begin
        read_data = read_data_reg;
    end

endmodule
